stellar_forge.name: Stellar Forge
stellar_forge.description: A star-powered foundry: +8 alloys here and +10% alloys empire-wide. One per empire.

grand_archive.name: Grand Archive
grand_archive.description: Every discovery of the empire, catalogued: +8 research here and +10% research empire-wide. One per empire.

galactic_exchange.name: Galactic Exchange
galactic_exchange.description: The sector's market floor: +10 credits here, +3 trade income per friendly minor power and better relations with everyone. One in the whole galaxy.

fleet_command_nexus.name: Fleet Command Nexus
fleet_command_nexus.description: A fleet-wide command net: +1 fleet movement, +10% hull repair per turn anywhere and +10 XP per turn for fleet commanders. One per empire.

ascension_gate.name: Ascension Gate
ascension_gate.description: A gateway to something beyond: complete it and your people ascend. Wins the game by science. Everyone sees it being built.
